prose.text:
Frame $K$ moves relative to the rod at speed $v$.
The rigid rod is at rest in inertial frame $K_1$, as shown in Figure 223.
Its length measured in $K_1$ is its rest length, or proper length, denoted by $l_0$.
prose.source_text: 使硬质棒在相对于参考系$K$以速度$v$运动的系统$K_1$中处于静止状态（图223）. 棒的静长，也就是在参考系$K_1$中测量出来的长度为$l_0$.

prose.text: Figure 223
prose.label: 图 223

prose.text:
To measure the moving rod in frame $K$, record both endpoint positions simultaneously according to that frame's synchronized clocks.
Their separation is the length $l$ measured in that frame.
Its relation to the proper length is:
prose.source_text: 在相对于棒运动的参考系$K$中，棒的长度$l$被看作是同时（按这个系统的钟）记录下来的棒的两端间的距离. 这样，根据相对论，得出以下公式：

prose.text:
For a nonzero relative speed below the speed of light, the contraction factor satisfies:
$\sqrt{1-\frac{v^2}{c^2}}<1$

The moving length along the direction of relative motion is therefore smaller than the same rod's proper length.
Dimensions perpendicular to the relative motion do not undergo this length contraction.
At zero relative speed, the measured length equals the proper length.
prose.source_text: 所以，运动的棒的长度小于静止的棒的长度.

prose.text:
Here, relativity of distance means that the measured separation of the same rod's endpoints depends on the reference frame.
It is connected to the same light speed in all inertial frames and to the relativity of time intervals.
prose.source_text: 距离的相对性（在目前分析的这个情况下，此距离为棒两端的距离）直接与在一切惯性参考系中的光速的恒定性及时间间隔的相对性有关.

prose.text:
Use the light clock from the preceding section to derive the length relation.
This time the rod is parallel to the relative velocity of the two frames, rather than perpendicular as before.
prose.source_text: 让我们用上一节谈到的“光学钟”来证明这一点，但此时棒的位置并不垂直于两系统相对运动的速度，而是与此速度平行.

prose.text:
A light pulse leaves endpoint $A$ and is reflected by the mirror at endpoint $B$, as shown in Figure 224.
In frame $K_1$, the pulse returns to A, and the clock on the rod measures the round-trip time $\tau_0$.

The rod's proper length is $l_0$, and each leg covers one proper length, so the time $\tau_0$ satisfies:
$c\tau_0=2l_0$ (8.3)
prose.source_text: 棒的一端（$A$）发射出来的光脉冲被位于棒的另一端（$B$）的镜子反射，并经过用在参考系 $K_1$ 中静止的钟测定的时间间隔 $\tau_0$ 以后又返回来（图 224）. 静止的棒的长度 $l_0$ 与时间 $\tau_0$ 的比例关系为$c\tau_0=2l_0$　　（8.3）

prose.text: Figure 224
prose.label: 图 224

prose.text:
In frame $K$, the first event is emission at $A$, and the second is reception at the moving A after reflection at mirror $B$.
This frame uses its own synchronized clocks to assign times to the events.

Their interval is $\tau$.
The proper time $\tau_0$ on the rod's clock and the interval $\tau$ are related by equation (8.1) from the preceding section.
prose.source_text: 用在系统 $K$ 中静止的钟测定的这两个事件之间的（从 $A$ 点发射信号和此信号从镜 $B$ 反射后回到此点）时间间隔用 $\tau$ 来表示. 间隔 $\tau_0$ 和$\tau$ 由公式（8.1）相互联系.

prose.text:
Let $\tau_1$ be the outbound travel time from $A$ to $B$.
Let $\tau_2$ be the return travel time in the opposite direction, with both times measured in frame K.

The total round-trip time is:
$\tau=\tau_1+\tau_2$.
prose.source_text: 如果 $\tau_1$ 是光信号从 $A$ 到 $B$ 的运动时间，$\tau_2$ 是此信号反方向运动的时间，则$\tau=\tau_1+\tau_2$.

prose.text:
Figure 225 shows three positions of the rod in frame $K$.
At emission the rod is at $AB$.
After time $\tau_1$ it is at $A_1B_1$ for reflection.

After time $\tau_1+\tau_2$ it is at $A_2B_2$ for reception.
During the outbound time $\tau_1$, the rod moves relative to $K$ through a distance $v\tau_1$.

As the pulse travels from $A$ toward $B$, the mirror moves away from the emission position.
The outbound path in $K$ is therefore $l+v\tau_1$, where $l$ is the rod length measured simultaneously in this frame.

Light still travels at speed c, so:
$l+v\tau_1=c\tau_1$.
Solving gives:
$\tau_1=\frac{l}{c-v}$.

When the pulse returns from $B$ to $A$, its path in frame $K$ is $l-v\tau_2$.
During time $\tau_2$, the receiving endpoint $A$ moves toward the pulse through a distance $v\tau_2$.

Thus:
$l-v\tau_2=c\tau_2$.
Solving gives:
$\tau_2=\frac{l}{c+v}$.

The round-trip time recorded by the clocks of $K$ is:
$\tau=\tau_1+\tau_2=\frac{2cl}{c^2-v^2}=\frac{2l}{c}\frac{1}{1-\frac{v^2}{c^2}}$ (8.4)

Using the time-interval relation (8.1) and the rest-length relation (8.3), the same total time is also:
$\tau=\frac{\tau_0}{\sqrt{1-\frac{v^2}{c^2}}}=\frac{2l_0}{c}\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\frac{v^2}{c^2}}}$ (8.5)
prose.source_text: 图 225 中所示为棒相对于参考系 $K$ 在各个不同时刻上的位置：在闪光发生的时刻在 $AB$ 位置，过了时间 $\tau_1$ 后在 $A_1B_1$ 位置，过了时间 $\tau_1+\tau_2$ 后在 $A_2B_2$ 位置. 在时间 $\tau_1$ 内，棒相对于系统 $K$ 移动了 $v\tau_1$ 距离. 光脉冲在从 $A$ 到 $B$ 运动时走过的路程从与系统 $K$ 相联系的观察者的角度来看，等于 $l+v\tau_1$（其中 $l$ 为运动着的棒的长度）. 所以可以写出下列方程式$l+v\tau_1=c\tau_1$所以$\tau_1=\frac{l}{c-v}$当光脉冲从 $B$ 到 $A$ 返回运动时，它走过的路程在参考系 $K$ 中等于 $l=$ $v\tau_2$，因为在时间 $\tau_2$ 之内，$A$ 点迎着光脉冲的位移距离为 $v\tau_2$. 因而$l-v\tau_2=c\tau_2$所以$\tau_2=\frac{l}{c+v}$根据参考系 $K$ 的时钟来看，光脉冲运动的全部时间等于：$\tau=\tau_1+\tau_2=\frac{2cl}{c^2-v^2}=\frac{2l}{c}\frac{1}{1-\frac{v^2}{c^2}}$　(8.4)根据公式(8.1)及(8.3)$\tau=\frac{\tau_0}{\sqrt{1-\frac{v^2}{c^2}}}=\frac{2l_0}{c}\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\frac{v^2}{c^2}}}$　(8.5)

prose.text: Figure 225
prose.label: 图 225

prose.text:
Equations (8.4) and (8.5) describe the interval between the same two events, so their right-hand sides are equal.
Canceling the common factors gives the relation (8.2) between the proper length and the moving length.
prose.source_text: 把(8.4)和(8.5)两个表示式用等号连接，我们可得到静止的棒和运动的棒长度之比(8.2).

prose.text: **Length measured along the direction of motion is not absolute, because it depends on the object's speed relative to the measuring frame**.
prose.source_text: **距离不是一种绝对的数值，它的大小取决于物体相对于某参考系运动的速度.**

prose.text:
For the same rod, the proper length is its greatest measured longitudinal length.
If instead the rod is at rest in frame $K$, its length there is $l_0$, while its longitudinal length measured in frame $K_1$ is contracted according to equation (8.2).
This agrees with the relativity principle and does not select a preferred inertial frame.
prose.source_text: 只有静止的棒比运动的棒长这一论点才是绝对的. 如果这一根棒在参考系 $K$ 中是处于静止状态，则它的长度在该参考系中等于 $l_0$，而相对于参考系 $K_1$ 则根据公式(8.2)棒长将变短. 根据相对性原理也应是这样.

prose.text: The contraction of moving lengths is therefore reciprocal.
prose.source_text: 尺寸的缩短具有明显的相互性质.

prose.text:
The source cites Eddington to note that reciprocal contraction challenges everyday intuition.
Compare two rods of equal proper length, each at rest in a different inertial frame and aligned with their relative motion.

Observers in each frame measure the other, moving rod to be shorter than their local, stationary rod.
They compare endpoint positions recorded simultaneously according to their own frame's clocks, not visual appearances.
The frames use different simultaneity conditions, so these symmetric measurements do not contradict each other.
prose.source_text: 这里，根据英国科学家爱丁格顿的说法，就发现和“健全的理性”存在着矛盾. 此矛盾和我们在《小人国》那里遇到的矛盾相比，要深远得多. 格列弗把侏儒看成小人，而侏儒们把格列弗看作巨人. 这是很自然的. 但是可能不可能侏儒们感到格列弗象矮子，而格列弗感到侏儒们也象矮子呢？须知我们在观察长度的相对缩短时遇到的正是类似的情形.
